entries.columnsContract: `candidate_package_id FK, ordinal, material_key, role(primary_payload|structural_dependency), mount_scope_id, inode, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, size_bytes, binding_revision, admitted_control_revision, admitted_control_projection_digest, member_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(candidate_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(candidate_package_id,material_key)`；ordinal从0连续；每行必须与Candidate Draft Unit、final Manifest member及对应immutable Run member的material/Physical Identity/size/binding/admitted Control逐项一致；Identity/size随Candidate Publication原子复制且published row immutable，历史Delivery不得旁读current Field Material补值

`PK(candidate_package_id,primary_ordinal,episode_key)`；复合FK指向`proc_candidate_primary_materials(candidate_package_id,ordinal)`；仅Series primary_payload允许非空，按episodeKey重建Manifest member的完整N:M Episode Claim set；single或structural_dependency不得有row

entries.columnsContract: `candidate_package_id FK, reference_id, primary_ordinal, role, material_key, mount_scope_id, inode, size_bytes, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, endpoint_id, location, association_kind(exclusive), disposition_required INTEGER, association_evidence_digest, disposition_basis_digest, reference_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(candidate_package_id,reference_id)`及复合FK`(candidate_package_id,primary_ordinal) → proc_candidate_primary_materials(candidate_package_id,ordinal)`；`CHECK(disposition_required=1)`；逐列无损保存一个`RelatedMaterialReference@1`，`primaryMaterialKey`只由该immutable FK目标重建；Physical Identity/materialKey、exclusive association、disposition basis及reference digest均按8.6.18重验；published row immutable，Related不进入Material Control但其dependent obligation随Handoff连续传播；Candidate关闭、Run封口或Offer关闭不得删除，历史Delivery Snapshot仍从本Owner relation恢复

entries.columnsContract: `offer_id PK, candidate_package_id FK, package_revision, package_digest, acceptance_basis_digest, state(open|accepted|rejected), handoff_decision_id NULL, handoff_decision_digest NULL, handoff_receipt_id NULL, handoff_receipt_digest NULL, terminal_evidence_digest NULL, offered_at_ms, closed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `rowMutability=cas_lifecycle`；唯一closed transition为expected `open → accepted|rejected`，terminal state不得转换或改写。`offer_id`与`acceptance_basis_digest`必须分别等于8.6.18从final `CandidatePackage@1`计算的`CandidateIntakeAcceptanceBasis@1`公式结果，且同事务存在唯一`ProcurementCandidateOfferAvailableMessage@1` Outbox；`UNIQUE(candidate_package_id,package_digest,acceptance_basis_digest)`；同一Candidate至多一个open Offer。open时全部handoff/terminal/closed列为NULL；accepted CAS一次性写Decision ID、Receipt ID/digest、terminal Evidence及closed time，Decision digest沿用既有nullable合同；rejected CAS一次性写全部handoff/terminal/closed列并逐项等于`LibraCandidateRejectedMessage@1`，`terminal_evidence_digest=receiptDigest`；这些终态列是write-once bundle，相同Offer/相同Evidence重放返回既有终态，不得执行第二次UPDATE、改写相反Outcome或新增row/Outbox；`INDEX(state,offered_at_ms)`

clean initialization建立唯一revision 0 row；`head_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.subject-continuity-head@1",headId,currentRevision}))`；任何改变active Subject集合、exact continuity relation或accepted Episode scope的事务都必须expected-revision CAS并加1，不能按时间戳伪造；Handoff A、Resolved Identity exact anchor publish与Subject terminal均使用同一head

entries.columnsContract: `intake_decision_id PK, decision_revision, decision_kind(accepted_resolution|rejected_acceptance), offer_id, candidate_package_id, package_revision, package_digest, acceptance_basis_digest, candidate_delivery_snapshot_digest, related_disposition_scope_digest, source_field_id, source_field_access_revision, source_field_context_digest, candidate_structure_kind, candidate_content_profile, candidate_identity_claim_digest, expected_continuity_head_revision NULL, expected_continuity_head_digest NULL, committed_continuity_head_revision NULL, candidate_continuity_set_digest NULL, candidate_episode_scope_digest NULL, match_cardinality NULL|none|one|multiple, matched_subject_set_digest NULL, episode_overlap_digest NULL, accepted_result NULL|new_subject|season_extension, target_subject_id NULL, expected_target_status NULL, expected_target_intake_revision NULL, expected_target_continuity_set_digest NULL, expected_target_episode_scope_digest NULL, committed_target_intake_revision NULL, committed_subject_continuity_set_digest NULL, committed_subject_episode_scope_digest NULL, accepted_payload_digest NULL, rejection_schema_ref NULL, rejection_id NULL, primary_rejection_code NULL, rejection_reason_set_digest NULL, rejection_digest NULL, decision_digest, decided_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `decision_revision=1`且`UNIQUE(offer_id)`；`intake_decision_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.intake-decision-id@1",offerId}))`；common Offer/Package/Acceptance Basis/Snapshot及Related disposition scope逐项匹配正式Delivery；六项source/profile provenance逐项复制Delivery Snapshot并成为Libra-owned immutable事实，不能在Routing时回读Procurement。无法取得完整Snapshot属于Delivery integrity/system failure，不伪造Rejected Decision。`accepted_resolution`要求continuity/match/overlap、accepted result/target、committed Subject digest及accepted payload完整非NULL，全部rejection列为NULL；其`decision_digest`逐字节等于`SubjectContinuityResolutionDecision@1.decisionDigest`。`rejected_acceptance`要求全部continuity/head/match/target/accepted列为NULL，rejection列完整非NULL；其`decision_digest`逐字节等于`IntakeRejectionDecision@1.decisionDigest`。`new_subject`要求target是Libra分配的新ID；`season_extension`要求one match/zero overlap、Candidate与Subject的`structure_kind/content_profile`逐字节相等及完整target CAS。Continuity无匹配、多匹配或Episode overlap仍是`new_subject`，不得成为rejection。同一Candidate/Package digest只允许一个accepted Decision的partial unique index；不同Acceptance Basis的新Offer可以各自保留Rejected Decision，但任何后续Accepted仍受该唯一约束；immutable，不接受调用者指定既有Subject或伪造head值

entries.columnsContract: `intake_decision_id FK, ordinal, subject_id FK, expected_subject_status(active), expected_subject_intake_revision, expected_subject_continuity_set_digest, expected_subject_episode_scope_digest, claim_kind, claim_namespace, claim_key, candidate_claim_digest, subject_claim_digest, subject_claim_provenance_kind(candidate|resolved_identity), subject_claim_provenance_ref, witness_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(intake_decision_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(intake_decision_id,subject_id)`；none为0 row、one恰为1 row、multiple恰为按subjectId UTF-8 bytes最小的2个distinct matching Subject witness；每个Subject选择按claim tuple/provenance稳定排序的第一项exact交集作为证明；`witness_digest=SHA-256(JCS(完整row business value excluding intakeDecisionId/ordinal/witnessDigest))`；它证明Decision所需0/1/N cardinality，不声称保存multiple分支的无界全量匹配集合

`PK(intake_decision_id,subject_id,episode_key)`；只允许match cardinality=one时保存Candidate Episode scope与唯一Subject current scope的完整交集，按episodeKey排序；`overlap_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.episode-overlap-member@1",subjectId,episodeKey}))`；zero overlap合法为0 row；multiple/none不执行overlap并为0 row；aggregate formula按8.6.18

entries.columnsContract: `intake_decision_id FK, reason_ordinal, reason_code, evidence_ordinal, evidence_schema_ref, evidence_id, evidence_digest, reason_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(intake_decision_id,reason_ordinal,evidence_ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(intake_decision_id,reason_ordinal,evidence_schema_ref,evidence_id,evidence_digest)`；每个reason ordinal至少一行，reason code按8.6.18 Handoff A closed precedence去重排序，组内Evidence按`evidence_schema_ref,evidence_id,evidence_digest`的UTF-8 bytes升序且唯一；同一reason ordinal全部row的reason code/digest相同；`reason_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"handoff-a-rejection-reason@1",reasonCode,evidenceRefs}))`；全部rows必须精确重建`IntakeStructuredRejection@1`的Reason集合，immutable；`INDEX(intake_decision_id,reason_ordinal,evidence_ordinal)`

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, intake_decision_id FK, outcome(accepted|rejected), offer_id, candidate_package_id, package_revision, package_digest, candidate_delivery_snapshot_digest, related_disposition_scope_digest, subject_id NULL, subject_intake_revision NULL, subject_continuity_head_revision NULL, subject_continuity_set_digest NULL, subject_episode_scope_digest NULL, accepted_payload_digest NULL, libra_binding_set_digest NULL, control_revision_set_digest NULL, rejection_id NULL, primary_rejection_code NULL, rejection_reason_set_digest NULL, rejection_digest NULL, receipt_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(intake_decision_id)`；同一Candidate/Package digest最多一个accepted Receipt的partial unique index，新的Acceptance Basis/Offer可以分别保留rejected Receipt。accepted要求Subject、accepted payload、Binding/Control及Related scope列全部非NULL且rejection列全NULL，重建`SubjectAndTransferReceipt@1`，其`ReceiptEnvelope.scopeDigest=accepted_payload_digest`，且`control_revision_set_digest`只由Primary Control transfer重建，不能包含Related；rejected要求Subject/accepted/Binding/Control列全NULL、rejection列全非NULL，重建`IntakeRejectionReceipt@1`。两种Receipt的Snapshot digest均逐字节等于对应Decision；相同marker重放不新增Receipt或消息

entries.columnsContract: `subject_id PK, structure_kind(single|season), content_profile(movie|series|jav|western_adult), routing_anchor_intake_decision_id FK, status, intake_revision, current_continuity_set_digest, current_episode_scope_digest, current_identity_revision NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `status`至少区分`active|abandoned|completed`；new Subject从Accepted Candidate固定`structure_kind/content_profile`、把创建它的Intake Decision固定为唯一Routing anchor且`intake_revision=1`；Season extension要求structure/profile相同、CAS加1并不得改写anchor，因此后续不同Field到达的Episode仍沿用该Season Subject既有Routing责任。`series`必须对应`season`，其余Beta profile对应`single`。continuity/Episode digest由本域relation rows按8.6.18重建；`current_identity_revision=NULL`是尚未发布Resolved Product Identity的唯一合法初值，正整数时显式复合FK指向`libra_product_identity_revisions(subject_id,revision)`；`INDEX(status,subject_id)`；Subject不保存Arca Shelf Entry/Deck状态

entries.constraintsContract: `PK(subject_id,claim_kind,claim_namespace,claim_key,provenance_ref)`；Handoff A复制Candidate claim；Resolved Product Identity发布`exactSeasonContinuityClaims`时以`provenance_ref={subjectId}:{identityRevision}`同事务追加；Intake只查询本关系的active Subject rows，不反解`provider_identity_set_digest`；`INDEX(claim_kind,claim_namespace,claim_key,subject_id)`允许检测0/1/N命中但不建立全局unique
